_doc: Long Calendar v2 (CI>=61.8 AND VRP<0) — May 6 2026. The first long-vega gate test in the codebase. Mirrors iron_condor v2's CI+VRP gate but flips the VRP threshold (cheap IV instead of rich IV). Same range condition as IC v2 because long-calendar profits from spot staying near strike (theta differential), and trending markets kill that. Mutually exclusive with IC v2 on the vol axis: when IC fires (VRP>0), LC blocks; when LC fires (VRP<0), IC blocks. Default LC params (entry_time, exit_time, profit_target, stop_loss, etc.) preserved — only the regime gate flag is set.
